'''Cell Block 1138''' was allegedly a detention area aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. When [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] discovered that [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was being held in [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]], he convinced the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to help him [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue]] the Princess. The two [[Human/Legends|Humans]], wearing [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]], "escorted" Chewbacca, a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], to AA-23.

When [[Shann Childsen/Legends|Shann Childsen]], the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in charge of the detention block, inquired as to where they were taking Chewbacca, Skywalker answered that he and Solo had been ordered to transfer the Wookiee from Cell Block 1138 to Detention Block AA-23. Having not been notified of the transfer, Childsen decided to check in with his superiors. Sensing that they could no longer further their deception, Skywalker, Solo, and Chewbacca opened fire on the detention block staff. It is unknown whether Cell Block 1138 actually existed or Skywalker improvised the name.

==Behind the scenes==
Luke Skywalker was originally to say the bogus "prison transfer" was to be from {{" '}}&hellip;cell block&hellip;' and then lots of letters and numbers," according to [[Mark Hamill]]. (Based upon the dialogue in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]], the original designation may have been '''TS-138''', or according to the [[Star Wars (1977) 3|Marvel comic adaptation]], '''TX-138'''.) When shooting the scene, Hamill decided to replace the original name of the cell block with "[[1138 (easter egg)|1138]]," a reference to director [[George Lucas]]'s first feature-length film, ''THX-1138''. Lucas was initially not impressed by Hamill's improvisation and told the actor, "Don't do that." However, the reference was retained in the [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|finished film]].
